'''Copper rocks''' are a type of rock that contains [[copper ore]]; they can be mined with a [[Mining]] level of 1. They are one of the first rocks that can be mined, along with [[tin rocks]]. Each time a player successfully mines a copper rock, they gain 17.5 Mining [[experience]]. 

Mining 14 [[tin ore]] and 14 copper ore (wielding the pickaxe as a [[weapon]] to free the 28th [[inventory]] space) and smelting them to [[Bronze bar|bronze bars]] is a slow but accessible way to train Mining and [[Smithing]], especially in [[free-to-play]] worlds.

For [[members]], players can [[power level]] the [[Mining]] skill with copper ore in the [[Port Khazard mine]] and amass ore. This is because of two fast [[respawn]]ing copper rocks that are very close to a [[bank deposit box]]. These two copper rocks are the closest mining rocks to a fast [[bank]] source, which surpasses the [[West Falador mine]] and level 5 [[Agility]] [[shortcut]].

On the other hand, free-to-play players can best gather their ores at the [[East Varrock Mine]], banking at [[Varrock east bank]]. There is an [[aggressive]] level 6 [[giant rat]] for players under 13 [[combat level|combat]] en route to the bank, however.

The rocks on [[Tutorial Island]] are slightly darker in colour, and do not grant experience past level 3 Mining.

==Equipment==
*{{plink|Varrock armour 1}}, 2, 3, and and 4 give a 10% chance to receive an extra ore.
*{{plink|Mining gloves}} allow one additional ore to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Superior mining gloves}} allow two additional ores to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Expert mining gloves}} allow three additional ores to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Celestial ring}}s and [[Celestial signet|signets]] provide an invisible +4 boost to Mining level, regardless of charges. When charged with [[stardust]], they also give a 10% chance to receive an extra ore.
*{{plink|Prospector kit|pic=Prospector helmet}} boosts Mining experience by 2.5%.
*{{plink|Amulet of glory|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} increases the chance of obtaining gems when charged.
*{{plink|Mining cape}}s give a 5% chance to receive an extra ore.
*Varrock armour, celestial rings, and Mining capes roll independently; multiple bonus resources can be given.
